_about: The port's template table: the entities the original ADDS at run time that no level of the game
places, written as the converter writes a placed one, so the port can build them (sim/Restock,
planning step 117). The simulation reads no .ent: a restock builds the node of a level that places
the entity (4-32's barrel_bomb), and otherwise the node this table gives. Restock::LoadTemplates
writes each entry as a .tscn node - an entity Node2D with its metadata, a Sprite2D, a Body and a
RectangleShape2D - and reads it back through Tscn::Parse, the strict reader every level goes through.
Each entry is checked field by field against the original's .ent (read in place under
reference/extracted/assets/entities, never copied here): size_px is its Collision Size times its
<Scale>, as the converter writes a placed body's shape (tscn.py _collider_lines, after CreateBody's
<Scale>; sprite its <Sprite>; body RigidBody2D for type 0 static 0; metadata its CustomData, quoted as
the converter quotes it, and the eth_ keys the converter writes for its EmissiveColor, applyLight and
<Normal>. What the port reads for no rigid body (friction, density) is named and not carried.
